FoldWhy.description: Why two accounts may be one person's. invite, share and browser: what the web app saw as the new account signed up. domain: an org proves the new account's address's domain. address: the address is proven on another account. seat: an account brings over a seat another of the person's accounts holds.

FoldHint.description: What the web app saw as the person signed up: an invite link, a shared page, or another account signed in on this browser before.

inviteToken.description: With hint invite: the invite link's token, so the answer can name its org.

FoldCatch.description: Whether to ask a new account's person if they already have an account.

mustFold.description: The address opens no account of its own: the person brings it to an account of theirs, or makes one with their own sign-in.

address.description: The new account's own sign-in address, shown only to its own person.

orgName.description: The org the invite, the proven domain or the address's proof is for.

inviteToken.description: With why invite: the invite link's token, so the confirmation names its org.

FoldIntent.description: A fold waiting for the person's other account to confirm it, on this browser, within ten minutes.

secret.description: Kept by the browser that started the fold; the other account sends it to confirm.

FoldPreview.description: What confirming the fold does, for the confirmation screen.

address.description: The work address the kept account proves.

keptName.description: The name of the account that stays.

seats.description: The orgs whose seats move to the account that stays.
